svt_parallelism: lp=0 selected Level of Parallelism 5 on this machine; asm AVX2
normalized_reference: Native resolution, 30 fps, YUV420 10-bit FFV1, BT.709 limited range; ProRes unspecified transfer treated as BT.709. Each resolution uses its own source and is not an identical-scene resolution scaling comparison.
quality_metric: libvmaf default vmaf_v0.6.1, native resolution, every 3rd frame, mean and sampled P5, PSNR and float SSIM. The default VMAF model is used as an SDR relative proxy within each resolution, not a validated 4K viewing-distance or HDR score.
limitations: No real HDR reference footage supplied
No power draw, package energy, or temperature measurement
30fps sources cannot represent unique-frame 60fps game motion; OBS renders them at 60fps
First exploratory OBS run failed before timer statistics; it is excluded and replaced by the sequential runs
FFV1 decode limits hardware quality-sweep throughput, so separate QSV decode/scale/encode timings are collected
